description: Hand-written question set. Every expected fact was checked against the text of the arXiv version named in `paper`. Facts are short exact strings; a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it contains one.

questions.question: What BLEU score does the big Transformer reach on WMT 2014 English-to-German?

What is the inner dimensionality of the position-wise feed-forward layers?
Which treebank is used for the English constituency parsing experiments?
What F1 does the 4-layer Transformer reach on WSJ section 23 in the semi-supervised setting?
What replaces sinusoidal positional encoding in row (E) of the model variations?
How many source tokens does each training batch contain approximately?
